title: Live interchangeability check
interpretation: Live interchangeability check (engines_live_check.json): the exact-SBML engine constructs in 5.0s and the surrogate runs 576 steps in 0.198s, finite over the horizon — all three engines expose the same observables and the MAP handoff column. The engine is a box you swap.
